text: Thirty years I guarded banks for men in good suits. Then I guarded this one for a man in a hood. The paperwork is always the same.
style: Turkish-German former bank vault security chief in his late fifties, now a true believer in the Crypto Anarchists' cause and Satoshi's minder. Speak with a consistent German accent (Hamburg) in fluent, careful English throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Low, gravelly pitch; slow, deliberate pace. Courteous and immovable; thirty years of guarding other people's money.
